newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-RANGERS EXTEND OATES AND GM.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-RANGERS EXTEND OATES AND GM.

text.p: The Texas Rangers Thursday gave manager Johnny Oates and general manager Doug Melvin one-year contract extensions through the 1998 season.
The terms of the contracts were not released.
Oates and Melvin helped the Rangers to the American League West title in 1996, the first post-season berth in franchise history.

Oates signed a two-year deal to manage the Rangers on October 19, 1994 and received a one-year contract extension last November. Melvin signed a three-year contract through 1997 when he was hired on October 10, 1994.
"The contributions that Doug Melvin and Johnny Oates have made to the Texas Rangers franchise over the last two years have been enormous," said Rangers president and general partner Tom Schieffer.
The Rangers were 90-72 last season and led the A.L. West for all but four days. Oates is 162-142 (.536) in two seasons as Rangers manager.
